IFL 2026-27: Gokulam Kerala thrashes Mohammedan SC to cement lead in Indian Football League
 The victory takes Gokulam Kerala to 12 points from four matches, keeping it at the top of the table, while Mohammedan SC remains second from bottom.

 Crislan Henrique scored a brace in the first half as Gokulam Kerala cruised to a 4-1 victory over Mohammedan Sporting in Kolkata.
 | Photo Credit: IFL Media
 Gokulam Kerala FC continued its impressive start to the Indian Football League (IFL) 2026–27 season with a commanding 4-1 victory over Mohammedan SC at the Kishore Bharti Krirangan in Kolkata on Friday.
 A brace from Crislan Henrique, alongside goals from Jobby Justin and captain Shikil N. S., helped the Malabarians maintain their unbeaten record and consolidate their position at the top of the standings.
 Jobby Justin opened the scoring in the seventh minute when Makan Chothe squared the ball into the centre, for Justin to finish with precision.
 Gokulam doubled its advantage in the 25th minute through a well-executed set-piece routine: Victor Da Silva delivering a delightful ball from the left following a corner, and Crislan rose above the defence to direct a powerful header into the far corner.
 ALSO READ: Chanmari inflicts third consecutive home loss to Rajasthan United in 4-1 win 
 The Brazilian forward struck again nine minutes later, and Shikil added a fourth in the 36th minute following a defensive error from the hosts.
 Mohammedan pulled one back through Jeremy Laldinpuia in first-half stoppage time, but Gokulam comfortably managed the second half to secure all three points.
 The victory takes Gokulam Kerala to 12 points from four matches, keeping it at the top of the table with a perfect record.
 Mohammedan SC, meanwhile, remains without a point after suffering its third consecutive defeat and currently is second from the bottom.
 Gokulam will have a rest in the next matchweek, while Mohammedan SC will look to bounce back when they host Rajasthan United FC on Wednesday, November 25.
Match score:
Mohammedan SC – 1 (Jeremy Laldinpuia 45’+3) lost to Gokulam Kerala FC – 4 (Jobby Justin 7’, Crislan Henrique 25’, 34’, Shikil N S 36’)
